workflows.heading: Dashboard
workflows.command: select an agent summary and open its detail view

assert: agent_id equals selected_agent_id
summary counts are sourced from persisted records

workflows.heading: Agents
workflows.command: create an agent

assert: agent_id equals created_agent_id
name and relationship equal submitted values

workflows.heading: People
workflows.command: create a person and record consent

assert: person_id equals created_person_id
grant status and expiry equal submitted values

workflows.heading: Locations
workflows.command: create a physical location

assert: location_id equals created_location_id
name and owning agent equal submitted values

workflows.heading: Spaces
workflows.command: create a space

assert: space_id equals created_space_id
agent, name, privacy, and room mode equal submitted values

workflows.heading: Devices
workflows.command: register a scoped device

assert: device_id equals created_device_id
agent, location, capabilities, and scopes equal submitted values

workflows.heading: Sessions
workflows.command: filter sessions and open one session receipt

assert: session_id equals selected_session_id
space, device, people, and lifecycle state are present

workflows.heading: Live Session
workflows.command: join a space and submit a typed turn

assert: user transcript event_id is present
agent response event_id is present
session and space attribution match

workflows.heading: Memories
workflows.command: annotate an immutable memory

assert: canonical content and kind are unchanged
new annotation id, author, type, comment, and weight are present

workflows.heading: Recognition
workflows.command: review a recognition hypothesis
browser_steps: submit accept, reject, or no-match decision

assert: decision equals submitted decision
observation, artifact, model, consent, reviewer, and audit ids are present

workflows.heading: Actions
workflows.command: create a targeted action proposal

assert: action_id equals created_action_id
target, policy state, approval state, and idempotency key are present

workflows.heading: Actions Guide
workflows.command: choose an action kind and create a validated proposal

assert: kind and validated payload equal submitted values
required scopes are persisted

workflows.heading: Tool Catalog
workflows.command: filter the catalog and inspect one tool contract
browser_steps: open its schema and policy detail

assert: name, input schema, and provider are present
required scopes and approval policy are present

workflows.heading: Personas
workflows.command: create and activate a persona revision

assert: persona_id equals created_persona_id
revision, instructions, author, and active state are present

workflows.heading: Graph
workflows.command: traverse from an owning-service TapDB object
browser_steps: obtain tapdb_euid from a persisted Marvain response

assert: root id equals the owner-provided EUID
typed lineage edges and neighbor depth are present

workflows.heading: Query
workflows.command: query TapDB by typed instance fields
browser_steps: select category, type, subtype, and version

assert: results satisfy every submitted filter
returned EUIDs are emitted by TapDB

workflows.heading: Audit
workflows.command: verify the audit chain and inspect an entry
browser_steps: open the receipt entry created by a prior workflow

assert: entry id, actor, operation, and object reference are present
prior hash, hash, and timestamp are present

workflows.heading: Observability
workflows.command: filter measured runtime state by run id
browser_steps: enter a prior workflow run id

assert: schema is marvain.observability.v1
measured worker, queue, database, TapDB, and dependency states are correlated to run_id

workflows.heading: Capability Matrix
workflows.command: filter capabilities and inspect accepted evidence

assert: score is derived from receipt evidence
implementation, local, browser, deployed, failure, observability, docs, and regression states are explicit

workflows.heading: Artifacts
workflows.command: upload and verify an artifact

assert: artifact id, checksum, size, media type, and storage URI are present
TapDB reference, lineage, retention, and audit ids are present

workflows.heading: Profile
workflows.command: verify the authenticated profile and membership view

assert: authenticated subject and email match the browser session
agent memberships and roles are server-derived
